---
title: Annotated cell without a list
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    code-annotations: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrors: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'Skylighting\(cell-id: "annotated-cell-1", annotations: \("1": 1\)'
        -
          - 'quarto-code-annotations:'
          - '# <1>'
---

::: {.cell}
```{.python .cell-code}
x = 1  # <1>
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
1
```
:::
:::

Plain paragraph, no list.
